semantics.attempts_2m: same account, observed events in (t-120s,t], current event included
semantics.attempts_1h: same account, observed events in (t-3600s,t], current event included
semantics.distinct_accounts_2m: distinct accounts sharing transient source in (t-120s,t], current event included
semantics.failed_ratio_24h: prior known synthetic outcomes in (t-24h,t], current outcome excluded; null if none
semantics.tie_order: CSV event order is causal ingestion order for equal timestamps; no later tied event is visible
semantics.hour_deviation: shortest circular distance from synthetic preferred hour in hours [0,12]
semantics.history: 30-day baseline is simulated profile parameters, NOT real observed history; warmup is explicitly synthetic
semantics.source_scope: customer-local transient random source key shared across accounts; no IP or fingerprint
semantics.retention: synthetic CSV/manifest are persistent test fixtures; this generator is not a live production TTL service
semantics.split: account-, episode-, session-, source-disjoint; sequential nonoverlapping time blocks

limitations: Entirely synthetic; no real-world effectiveness or calibrated compromise probability is established.
Scenario distributions are authored simulations with overlap, not measured customer behavior.
Cold start or absent recent history creates unknown features; consuming models must abstain or explicitly handle uncertainty.
Source correlation is synthetic. Real customer integration must supply a privacy-preserving transient source key.
Geo velocity is synthetic context sampled without coordinates; VPN jumps are not proof of physical travel.
